an7.62:1.2: sukhass' etaṃ bhikkhave adhivacanaṃ, yad idaṃ puññānan ti.
an7.62:1.3: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ dīgharattaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ vipākaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ.
an7.62:1.5: satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na yimaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ,
an7.62:1.6: saṃvaṭṭamāne sudāhaṃ bhikkhave loke Ābhassarupago homi,
an7.62:2.1: Tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave Brahmā homi Mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso Vasavattī.
an7.62:2.2: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave Sakko ahosiṃ devānam indo.
an7.62:2.3: Anekasattakkhattuṃ rājā ahosiṃ Cakkavattī dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato.
an7.62:2.4: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave imāni satta ratanāni ahesuṃ, seyyathīdaṃ
an7.62:2.5: cakkaratanaṃ hatthiratanaṃ assaratanaṃ maṇiratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ, parināyakaratanam eva sattamaṃ.
an7.62:2.6: Paro sahassaṃ kho pana me bhikkhave puttā ahesuṃ sūrā vīraṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
an7.62:2.7: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasan ti.
an7.62:12.4: saraṃ buddhānasāsanan ti.] 1. Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā
